selected_evidence.requirement: Shared VIP configured on node1/node2 via VRRP (keepalived) answered by one node at a time
selected_evidence.summary: UCI keepalived config committed on both nodes; after service restart node1 (priority 150) holds the VIP 10.100.53.200/24 as MASTER while node2 (priority 100) is BACKUP with no VIP.

selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline: node3 reaches the shared VIP before any disruption
selected_evidence.summary: node3 pings VIP 10.100.53.200 with 0% packet loss while node1 is MASTER.

selected_evidence.requirement: Demonstrate automatic failover to the other node while node3 keeps reaching the VIP
selected_evidence.summary: Continuous ping started on node3; node1's keepalived stopped, releasing the VIP; node2 immediately took over the VIP; node3's ping log shows only one transient delayed reply (icmp_seq 17) out of 88 total replies, with no full loss.

selected_evidence.requirement: Restore and verify recovery/preemption after the disruption
selected_evidence.summary: keepalived restarted on node1; node1 re-claimed the VIP via priority preemption, node2 released it, and node3's ping to the VIP shows 0% loss post-recovery.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-reboot boot_id 0d9d51de captured with keepalived running; reboot acknowledged; post-poll boot_id changed to b183912b with uptime 0 min; keepalived auto-started and running as BACKUP with br-lan up.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state, cluster VRRP membership recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-reboot boot_id e64a7d78 captured while node1 held the VIP; reboot acknowledged; during the outage node2 automatically took the VIP (verified) and node3 kept reaching it; post-poll boot_id changed to d337301b with uptime 0 min; keepalived auto-started, node1 re-preempted the VIP, node2 stood down, and node3 ping to VIP succeeded.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-reboot boot_id 4cee4ea8 captured; reboot acknowledged; post-poll boot_id changed to de40a4c0 with uptime 0 min; node3 regained its enp1s0 address and successfully pinged the shared VIP with 0% packet loss.

	[ -n "$name" ] && printf ' %s' "$name" >> "$KEEPALIVED_CONF"
	printf ' {\n' >> "$KEEPALIVED_CONF"
}

config_section_close() {
	printf '}\n\n' >> "$KEEPALIVED_CONF"

config_foreach_wrapper() {
	local section="$1"

	local config="$1"

			opt="${opt:7}"
			no_val=1
		fi
		config_get "$opt" "$config" "$opt"

	done
	unset optval
